description: Retrieve the full text of any section of the Catalunya 2022 document by its canonical slug. Slugs follow the pattern: 'sphere-1', 'sphere-1/goal-2', 'sphere-1/goal-2/action-2-1'. Static pages: 'introduction', 'executive-summary', 'train-of-prosperity'. Use get_document_metadata to discover all available slugs.

locale.description: Content language. Defaults to 'ca' (Catalan), the original language of the document. (ca=Catalan, en=English, es=Spanish)

name: get_section
title: Read a section
